primary.title: Employer gifts up to ₹15,000 now tax-free: Here's what salaried taxpayers need to know about the higher limit
primary.summary: The Income Tax Rules, 2026 have raised the annual tax-free limit on employer-provided gifts, vouchers and tokens from ₹5,000 to ₹15,000. The benefit is available as an aggregate annual limit, not separately for each occasion.
